entries.reason: The activity dots are fixed 4x4 px circles; radius 2 is half the dot, a shape rather than a theme corner size.
The switch thumb radius 9 is half its fixed 18 px size; the 12 px checkbox mark radius 2 has no theme metric because radii covers control and panel surfaces only.
The switch track radius 12 is half its fixed 24 px height, a capsule; the 24 px checkbox box radius 4 has no theme metric because radii covers control and panel surfaces only.
The slider rail and fill are fixed 6 px tall; radius 3 is half that height, a capsule shape.
The slider thumb is a fixed 24x24 px circle; radius 12 is half the thumb, not the panel radius it happens to equal.
LevelPicker bar segments round their 20 to 36 px bars by 2 px; the theme has no segment radius and radii.control would turn thin bars into pills.
The StatusIndicator ring thickness is a sixth of the indicator diameter with a 2 px floor, so it scales with the ring.
The StatusIndicator cutout is a 1 px gap painted in the surface color by .facet-cutout; it separates the dot from content and is not the hairline role.
The progress trail is a translucent echo of the .facet-fill accent; the palette has no trail opacity, and 0.6 is relative to the themed fill color.
Avatar initials are sized to 40 percent of the avatar diameter with an 8 px floor, so they fit the circle at every size.

Only an authored backgroundTransparency reaches this black plate; the catcher stays untagged so .facet-scrim cannot override the caller's value (commit 91702428), and unauthored scrims use the theme rule.
